means: Long arc of 6 to 12 stories toward one capability, on real artefacts with pre-registered measures; each story is one pass of the rigid order.
Which harness runs a story sessions: 0 cheap-model WebHarness, 1 with query surface and striping, 2 Claude Code through the gateway.
Recorded check (G0, G1, G2, GB, GJ) that must exist before a driver stage or story group opens; met by records, not dates.

name: driver stage ladder
claim: Cheap non-Anthropic models in the current harness carry draft-level planning and research stories; stages 1 and 2 are promoted by recorded gates and same-story comparisons. Refuted if stage 0 cannot produce usable drafts (A1.1, A3.1 baselines).

name: read path: query surface and striping lower tokens per solved task
claim: Under a new strategy, query and query_ref (plus striping where it pays) take tokens per solved task on large-result shapes to 70 percent or less of strat-stem-1.0 with solve rate no lower. Refuted by the A1.5 canary or A1.7 silo run.

name: stage 2 opens on measured route gates
claim: Claude Code through the credential-blind gateway keeps cache-hit within 2 points of direct (R13), accepts halts without retry (R14, R12) and thinking handling is settled (R6a, R17); then a stage-2 pilot story completes at no worse quality than stage 0. Refuted by any gate or by A2.7.

name: pitch dry run finds the issues before the live flow
claim: A flow pitched with a hypothesis and dry-run against existing conventions surfaces at least half of the issues later seen live, so the protocol swap happens before spend. Refuted if the dry run misses most live issues.

name: six contracts carry real harness event shapes
claim: Clock, stream, store, surface, module and identity carry at least 7 of 10 real harness event shapes (ledger row, trail row, tool call, concern, catalog line, profile entry, fold, handle, stem, validator record). Refuted if more than three need a new contract.

name: as-of read equals the git view of the catalog
claim: An as-of read over event records of catalog supersedes chains equals the catalog view computed from git history at the same commit, over at least 20 commits. Refuted by any disagreement not explained by a recorded rule.

name: reviewer app reproduces the manual descriptive pass
claim: A reviewer app reading wh records through as-of reads and the mapped query surface reproduces scripts/turn-profile.mjs counts exactly on one real session and misses no more than 20 percent of the drill-ins the operator made by hand. Refuted otherwise.

name: data-not-instruction by provenance rule on a real corpus
claim: A provenance-and-principal rule classifies at least 90 percent of a 30-item real corpus of tool results and file contents correctly as data, better than a keyword list, with enforcement left an option. Refuted below that or no better than keywords.

fault: a Bash call under msys passed /tmp/usedids.txt to a node script; node on Windows resolved C:/tmp and failed with ENOENT
handled: pipe the file on stdin (cat file | node -e ... readFileSync(0)) or give node an absolute Windows path; msys /tmp is not visible to node
evidence: steward session 2026-11-21, readFileSync ENOENT on the tmp path

fault: a node -e script wrote a Windows path with backslashes inside a JS string; the sequence backslash-u began an invalid unicode escape and the script did not compile
handled: use forward slashes in paths inside node -e, or write the script to a file first
evidence: steward session 2026-11-21, SyntaxError: Invalid Unicode escape sequence
